name: US total market (1926–)
note: Cumulative daily total return of the CRSP value-weighted US market, rebuilt as (Mkt-RF + RF) from the Fama/French daily research factors. Base 1.0 at the close of the first row (1926-07-01); that day's own return is not applied. Ken French rebuilds from CRSP monthly, so this series lags live price data by up to six weeks.
